verdict.rationale: Once enabled, Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new PR in selected repositories with no further configuration, and custom rules and exclusions shape its behavior. The stack-aware merge queue also lands PRs on its own, and the pricing page lists an "Automations" feature. The Agents feature, however, runs on demand from a prompt rather than in the background. Missing for 10: documentation of what the "Automations" feature does and how users configure their own triggers and actions, evidence of autonomous background agents beyond PR review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
